_comment: Agent name roster. Every name belongs to exactly one model family and each family has at least five, so a name always identifies the model. The first pattern matching the lower-cased model id (spaces, dots, slashes and underscores turned into '-') wins, so pattern order matters. Concurrent agents on one family take its next free name, in list order. A model matching no pattern is refused: add a family here. Who currently holds which name is local state in .agents/local/agent-names.json (never committed).

models.why: the greatest conquerors and sovereigns: the strongest Claude model
formidable rulers and master statesmen: planning and architecture
field commanders who win the main battles: development
brave individuals with one clear mission: chores
grand strategists and state builders: design-heavy work
strong rulers and able viziers: routine implementation
empire builders and grand sovereigns: Google's largest Gemini model
brilliant conquerors and restorers: Google's flagship frontier reasoning model
steadfast march lords and state architects: deep reasoning and heavy analysis
stalwart commanders and fortress victors: core development and refactoring
swift vanguard riders and messengers: agile and lightweight execution
compact scouts and local operatives: on-device and embedded tasks
fast, agile irregular fighters: routine edits and test runs
